label: TEST ONLY. Pre-registration committed before any v0.1.20 result exists. Thresholds are the locked section 2 table. No measured results in this file.

locked_decisions.name: v0.1.20
locked_decisions.v0_2: reserved for the first product-facing page
locked_decisions.power_board: Lattice ECP5 Versa or an equivalent open-source-friendly ECP5 45F/85F board

ops.ops_total: sum of compute fields over encode_ops and decode_ops, plus instrumented agent compute ops
ops.agent_gap: instrumented agent compute ops minus the analytic agent formula (cells evaluated × compares, plus the same navigation reads). Both are reported.
ops.sha256_per_frame: not in the op total; the subsystem temporal surface hash is not added

bytes.bytes_moved: encode.bytes_in + encode.bytes_out + decode.bytes_in + decode.bytes_out + encode.state_bytes_touched + decode.state_bytes_touched + agent.bytes_in + agent.bytes_out + agent.state_bytes_touched

arms.e1: lossless and bounded engine modes (fixture tenant scp-v01-fixture) → adapter → full_f64, full_q, delta, tensor_bound, tensor_energy, scp4d
arms.e3: same agent on the full surface and on each reconstructed gate arm; navigation and threshold decision; 5 seeds × 4 episodes at medium churn
arms.e4: relations on/off × rank 0/1/2 × predictor zero/last/linear, at medium churn, episode 0, 5 seeds
arms.e5: every strategy on the single-cell frame fixtures (v0.1, synthetic Medicare 6-row, B256, B4096); read-only; no PHI
arms.h2_not_a_gate: tensor_energy is an unbounded probe (E1, E4 is scp4d-only, E5). It is reported and is not an H2 gate arm, matching the v0.1.9 bounded-strategy rule.

task.navigation: greedy step to the neighbour with strictly smaller c2 (manhattan distance to cell 0); c2 is not churned
task.retention: per seed, min(navigation success on reconstructed / navigation success on the full surface, threshold agreement). If full-surface navigation success is 0, retention is 1 when reconstructed success is also 0 and 0 otherwise. Steps-to-goal are reported and are not a gate.

H1.name: Fidelity
H1.pass: bound_ok on every bounded arm, every seed
H1.mixed: none: this is a hard gate

H2.name: Intelligence
H2.pass: safe_disagree = 0 on all seeds, and task success retained >= 0.99 on every seed
H2.mixed: safe_disagree = 0 but retention under 0.99 on any seed

H3.name: Redundant processing
H3.pass: event-driven scp4d ops per transition >= 1.5× lower than full-scan full_q and lower than delta (median of 5 seeds, holding in >= 4 of 5) at low and medium churn
H3.mixed: between 1.0× and 1.5×, or only at the lowest churn
H3.aggregation: median of the 5 per-seed ratios; a seed holds when its ratio is >= 1.5 and its scp4d ops are strictly lower than delta

H4.name: Data movement
H4.pass: scp4d bytes moved <= delta and <= full_q at low and medium churn
H4.mixed: wins on stream bytes but loses on state bytes touched
H4.aggregation: the comparison is on the median of the 5 seeds, at low and at medium churn

H5.name: Crossover
H5.pass: the churn level where H3 flips is measured and reported
H5.fail: no flip found in the sweep (reported as a finding, not a failure of the build)
H5.flip: the first churn in low, medium, high, very_high order where the H3 level test goes from holding to not holding

latency: p50 / p95 per transition (JS, one machine) are printed by the harness and stored under reported_not_asserted. Never a gate. Not part of the deterministic body.
energy: needs real board. No numeric estimate is written.

system_model.note: The system model must reproduce an existing exact decoder cycle model with 0 cycles of difference, and the K1 exact cycle model with 0 cycles of difference. A coarser closed form may be printed beside them and is not a gate.

selector.gate: bit-exact AND fits AND five seeds
selector.five_seed_source: v0.1.19 manifest (not on main in this run)

naming_note: v019 in older filenames means v0.1.9. From v0.1.20 onward, tags are four digits (v0120). v0119 means v0.1.19.
